lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a rectilinear grid formation posterior to the gill slits and extending toward the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are clearly visible, intersecting the horizontal spot rows to form high-contrast anchor nodes in a checkerboard pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance upper surfaces to shadowed lower surfaces.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense population of small, low-intensity spots that are significantly smaller and more concentrated than the primary flank constellation.
